scope_notes: Scoped run focused on the Portfolio dashboard view and its detail pane interaction. Uses the `?d=portfolio` URL param on the single-page client root. Detail pane opens via row click and is reflected as `?d=portfolio&c=<companyId>` in the URL.

screens.name: Portfolio dashboard
screens.notes: Banner + signal filter + sort dropdown + 774-row list with stage chip, signal pill, dot-encoded extras, health/revenue/last-contact, owner avatar. Power-user keyboard surface (⇧F, ⇧S, ↑↓, ↵, 1-8, 0, S, ⌘S).

screens.name: Portfolio dashboard + company detail pane
screens.notes: Side-panel detail. Opens by clicking a row or pressing ↵ on the focused row in the portfolio list. Companion of PortfolioView — agents should navigate to /?d=portfolio first, then click the first row to open the detail pane and audit it in context.
